package.author: Jack Vasti

en-US.author: Jack Vasti
en-US.longDescription: Imageboard/booru downloader which can download thousands of images from multiple boorus very easily. Thanks to its powerful naming features, you just have to set your filename and save directory using all the tokens available, and the program will generate a filename using the image's information.
en-US.name: Grabber

zh-CN.description: 图像板（booru）浏览器与批量下载器。
zh-CN.longDescription: 图像板/booru 下载器，可以轻松地从多个 booru 图像板批量下载数千张图片。凭借强大的命名功能，你只需使用所有可用的标记设置文件名和保存目录，程序就会根据图片的信息生成文件名。
